name: Zunvra Intelligence Suite
description: Advanced OSINT intelligence analysis skill for the Zunvra/Central Intelligence real-time dashboard. Provides 26 autonomous capabilities + full dashboard remote control + autonomous intelligence broadcasting + autonomous camera pilot that drives the map. Surpasses Palantir Gotham and matches IC agency coverage.
author: OpenSable

capabilities.name: Intelligence Broadcaster
capabilities.description: Autonomous OSINT-to-social-media pipeline: consumes live data across 14+ domains, identifies noteworthy patterns and cross-domain correlations, takes cinematic dashboard screenshots (NVG/FLIR/THERMAL), and composes analyst-style posts. Integrates with X autoposter for organic intelligence showcasing.

capabilities.name: Autonomous Camera Pilot
capabilities.description: Sable autonomously drives the dashboard map during analysis: flies to alert locations, changes zoom based on domain (facility/theater/global), switches visual styles per context (NVG for military, THERMAL for nuclear/fires, CRT for cyber, RADAR for maritime), highlights findings with attention rings, narrates investigation via toast notifications. Supports patrol mode, reactive snap-to-alert, dwell zoom, and cinematic transitions.
